title: UI frame
description: A frame for UI captures: a browser window (three dots, a tab with a title, a URL bar with the url) or a phone or tablet (a body, a rounded screen, a camera or notch), around a picture or a screen recording given as `content`. The chrome takes the theme's colours (light or dark) and casts a soft shadow; the capture is drawn at the size of the viewport (at scale 1 a one-to-one copy of the footage). Chrome text is a share of the frame's short side, with a floor. Pairs with kit-camera, kit-cursor and kit-spotlight. Takes a theme.

content.description: The capture: an image asset or footage (empty: a placeholder screen)

fit.description: How the capture fills the viewport or screen

url.description: Shown in the browser's URL bar

chrome.description: auto takes the colours of the theme; light or dark forces a neutral set

scale.description: Browser only: 0 fits the window to the box; a number draws the capture at that multiple of its own size (1 = pixel for pixel)

aspect.description: Width over height of the browser viewport (0: the capture's own, or 16:10 without one)

orientation.description: Phone and tablet: auto is portrait for a phone and landscape for a tablet

size.description: Chrome text size in % of the frame's short side (the bars grow with it)

shadow.description: Strength of the drop shadow (0 = none, and no room is kept for it)

inDur.description: Seconds it takes to ease in (0: there from the first frame)

author: claude-opus-5-5
